item: An ordinary close after the data drive was swapped never deletes the other drive's -wal/-shm
summary: The dialect close is patched from import: before closing a pool connection with a file (main or ATTACHed) in the watched data folder it asks data_volume.probe; absent, unidentified or another drive => pinned, never closed (pool recycle, shutdown and atexit disposal). DuckDB serves kept and offload folder left on the same question; the shutdown write-back skips (drive-changed); refused builds and persisted refreshes say drive-changed instead of encryption/no-passphrase; a cached persisted serve on a gone drive is taken out and never refreshed; DuckDB ConnectionException counts as closed only for already closed. tmpfs mount test: without the check the ordinary shutdown deletes the other drive's log; with it every file is byte-identical.
